in_arabic.name: Fikriyya
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Memory, Thought, Intention
in_arabic.long_meaning: Fikriyya هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Fikriyya is an Arabic name derived from the root 'fakara' which means to remember or to think. This name signifies a person who is deeply engaged in their thoughts and memories. In Islamic context, Fikriyya is a name of high reverence as it is associated with the remembrance and contemplation of Allah.
